functions.tax_pct_for_region: tax_pct_for_region(region: str|None) -> Decimal. None (unknown customer) -> Decimal(0). Unknown region string -> KeyError.
functions.compute_tax: compute_tax(region: str|None, discount_pct: number, lines: list[tuple[str,int]]) -> int. lines = [(category, line_amount_cents)], line_amount_cents is an int in cents. Exempt categories are excluded. Returns tax in integer cents.

value.rounding: Decimal, half up, once at the end
value.errors: KeyError for unknown region; ValueError for discount outside [0,100]

why: tax.py takes plain values only, so it has no dependency on pricing.py. invoice.py gets region and discount from pricing and passes them in. Customer unknown => region None => 0 tax.
agent3 (invoice): accept. invoice.py converts money at the boundary (pricing float dollars -> int cents) and passes discount percent (e.g. 10) and region/None.
